create.name: Sarah Hall
create.bio:
Sarah Hall is an angel channel and spiritual teacher based in Michigan who works with angels, ascended masters and spirit guides. She describes a childhood of unusual sensitivity, including an early sense of closeness to Mother Mary, and first channelled a spirit at fifteen. Overwhelmed, she shut the ability away for several years, until a night when she called on the angels and felt Archangel Michael answer; from then on she set about learning to use her gifts in a grounded way. People began to ask her for readings and guidance, and over more than a decade her clients have come from some twenty-five countries.

Today most of her teaching reaches people online. Her YouTube channel carries channelled angel messages, often tied to new and full moons, eclipses and solstices, alongside talks on integration and holding a steady vibration. She has recorded more than twenty guided meditations, among them journeys with Mother Mary, St Brigid and the Seraphim, presents a podcast called Through the Eyes of the Angels, and runs Angelic Ascension, an application-only group programme on psychic development, shadow work and channelling. Her teaching keeps returning to self-discovery as the doorway to the divine.

courses.title: Angelic Ascension group coaching programme
courses.description: Sarah's group programme for people on an awakening path, covering psychic development, work with angels and guides, shadow work and training as a channel. Entry is by application, after which applicants are invited to a free introductory training.

courses.title: Mother Mary Meditation
courses.description: A downloadable guided journey into the presence of Mother Mary as a figure of compassion and divine love. It centres on resting in her care and opening to a sense of oneness with God and others.

courses.title: Crystal Heart Meditation
courses.description: A downloadable meditation that links you with what Sarah calls the Crystal Ray, a higher-dimensional light. The practice is aimed at softening the heart and growing compassion for yourself and all beings.

courses.title: Guided Meditation for Higher Consciousness with the Seraphim
courses.description: A downloadable practice for attuning to the Seraphim, the angelic order Sarah sees as closest to the divine. It is designed to lift awareness and let you rest in a feeling of divine love.

courses.title: Guided Meditation for Heavenly Peace with the Angels
courses.description: A short downloadable journey in which the angels help you recall a deep, heavenly calm. You then practise carrying that sense of peace out into daily life.

courses.title: The Healer’s Initiation Meditation with St. Brigid
courses.description: A downloadable visualisation to St Brigid's temple in the spirit world, drawing on her place as both Celtic goddess and Christian saint. It is offered as an initiation for people who feel called to work as healers.

free_resources.title: Sarah Hall on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided angel meditations, including journeys with Mother Mary, Archangel Michael, St Brigid and the Seraphim, plus practices on forgiveness and self-love. Free to listen.

free_resources.title: How to Receive Angelic Guidance
free_resources.description: A short free article in which Sarah explains how she understands intuitive contact with the angels. It closes with a simple intention to place the mind under their guidance.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 127K (channel header next to @SarahHall444, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram 9,915 (og:description of @sarahhall444, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook 5,202 (page description of sarahhall444, 1 Nov 2026); Insight Timer 2.8k (profile, 1 Nov 2026) → ~145k total → luminary
flags: Tier borderline: ~145k total, inside the 80k–150k band; almost all of it is her YouTube channel.
Email is a support inbox (support@sarahhall.com, Cloudflare-encoded in the footer of her members' sign-in page); her main site has a contact form.

Her about page tells her own story of depression, anxiety, addiction and abuse before her work with the angels; this is personal history, not a sales claim, and the bio leaves it out. A human may still want to check the health rule.
Psychic Protection with Archangel Michael (her best-known meditation) was left out because its description mentions health and safety; Healing with Jesus was left out as borderline by title.
Videos chosen from the 30 most recent uploads only (the Popular sort needs YouTube's internal API); most uploads are dated moon or eclipse updates, which were skipped.
Photos: all three are styled portraits of the same woman (Insight Timer and YouTube avatar are crops of the about-page shoot).
Insight Timer bio could only be captured as quoted excerpts; the bio check ran against those plus her site pages.
left_out: Guided Angel Meditation for Pregnancy and Guided Meditation for Deep, Healing Sleep with the Angels: condition-related titles.
Psychic Protection with Archangel Michael and the 5-Minute Energy Cleansing meditation: descriptions mention health or feeling anxious.
Angel Mystery School courses (members.sarahhall.com): behind a login, no public course pages or prices.
Guided Meditation for Stillness: newsletter sign-up gift with no page of its own.
Through the Eyes of the Angels podcast: no fitting free-resource type.
Dated YouTube videos (full moon, new moon, eclipse, equinox, solstice and monthly energy updates) and 'Do This to Heal at the Root!' (healing title).
Individual Insight Timer tracks: covered by the profile link.
